description: A gray plastic tub with several clear ice cubes sits on the table, with a small yellow cup to its left and a purple scoop to its right. The right hand lifts the purple scoop, dips it into the gray tub, and scoops up ice while the left hand steadies the tub’s rim; then the left hand picks up the yellow cup and holds it under the scoop as the right hand tips the scoop to dump the ice into the cup, before the right hand moves the scoop away.
